arxiv-2004-04070.title: Are All Good Word Vector Spaces Isomorphic?
arxiv-2004-04070.creator: Ivan Vulić Sebastian Ruder Anders Søgaard
arxiv-2004-04070.description: Abstract Existing algorithms for aligning cross-lingual word vector spaces assume that vector spaces are approximately isomorphic. As a result, they perform poorly or fail completely on non-isomorphic spaces. Such non-isomorphism has been hypothesised to result from typological differences between languages. In this work, we ask whether non-isomorphism is also crucially a sign of degenerate word vector spaces .

arxiv-2105-00131.description: Abstract The problem of long-tailed recognition, where the number of examples per class is highly unbalanced, is considered. It is hypothesized that the well known tendency of standard classifier training to overfit to popular classes can be exploited for effective transfer learning. arxiv-2109-06274.title: Cross-Modality Domain Adaptation for Vestibular Schwannoma and Cochlea Segmentation
arxiv-2109-06274.creator: Han Liu, Yubo Fan *, Can Cui, Dingjie Su, Andrew McNeil, Benoit M. Dawant
arxiv-2109-06274.description: Abstract Automatic methods to segment the vestibular schwannoma (VS) tumors and the cochlea from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are critical to VS treatment planning. Although supervised methods have achieved satisfactory performance in VS segmentation, they require full annotations by experts, which is laborious and time-consuming.

arxiv-2112-14321.title: A Correctly Rounded Newton Step for the Reciprocal Square Root
arxiv-2112-14321.creator: Carlos F. Borges
arxiv-2112-14321.description: Abstract . The reciprocal square root is an important computation for which many sophisticated algorithms exist (see for example [ 7 , 2 , 3 ] and the references therein). A common theme is the use of Newton’s method to refine the estimates.

arxiv-2202-10325.title: Reducing the Gibbs effect in multimodal medical imaging by the Fake Nodes Approach
arxiv-2202-10325.creator: Davide Poggiali, Diego Cecchin, Stefano De Marchi
arxiv-2202-10325.description: Abstract It is a common practice in multimodal medical imaging to undersample the anatomically-derived segmentation images to measure the mean activity of a co-acquired functional image. This practice avoids the resampling-related Gibbs effect that would occur in oversampling the functional image.

arxiv-2207-11514.title: Semantic Abstraction: Open-World 3D Scene Understanding from 2D Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2207-11514.creator: Huy Ha, Shuran Song
arxiv-2207-11514.description: Abstract We study open-world 3D scene understanding, a family of tasks that require agents to reason about their 3D environment with an open-set vocabulary and out-of-domain visual inputs – a critical skill for robots to operate in the unstructured 3D world.

arxiv-2303-06722.title: STM observation of the hinge-states of bismuth nanocrystals
arxiv-2303-06722.creator: Tianzhen Zhang, Valeria Sheina, Sergio Vlaic, Stéphane Pons, Dimitri Roditchev, Christophe David, Guillemin Rodary, Jean-Christophe Girard, Hervé Aubin
arxiv-2303-06722.description: Abstract The recent application of topological quantum chemistry to rhombohedral bismuth established the non-trivial band structure of this material. This is a 2 nd order topological insulator characterized by the presence of topology-imposed hinge-states. The spatial distribution of hinge-states and the possible presence of additional symmetry-protected surface-states is expected to depend on the crystal shape and symmetries.

arxiv-2410-22543.title: Near-Earth Asteroids as the Parents of the δ \delta -Cancrid Meteoroid Stream
arxiv-2410-22543.creator: G. I. Kokhirova, M. Zhang, X.-G. Li, A. I. Zhonmuhammadi, X. Liu
arxiv-2410-22543.description: Abstract The δ \delta -Cancrid meteoroid stream forms four active meteor showers which are observable on the Earth annually during January-February and August-September. The stream’s definite parent comet has not been established. We performed a search for near-Earth asteroids (NEAs) associated with this stream.

arxiv-2503-12383.title: VRsketch2Gaussian: 3D VR Sketch Guided 3D Object Generation with Gaussian Splatting
arxiv-2503-12383.creator: Songen Gu, Haoxuan Song, Binjie Liu, Qian Yu, Sanyi Zhang, Haiyong Jiang, Jin Huang, Feng Tian
arxiv-2503-12383.description: Abstract We propose VRSketch2Gaussian , a first VR sketch-guided, multi-modal, native 3D object generation framework that incorporates a 3D Gaussian Splatting representation. As part of our work, we introduce VRSS , the first large-scale paired dataset containing VR sketches, text, images, and 3DGS, bridging the gap in multi-modal VR sketch-based generation.

arxiv-2512-23356.title: A Stepwise-Enhanced Reasoning Framework for Large Language Models Based on External Subgraph Generation
arxiv-2512-23356.creator: Xin Zhang, Yang Cao, Baoxing Wu, Xinyi Chen, Kai Song, Siying Li
arxiv-2512-23356.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across a wide range of natural language processing tasks in recent years, including machine translation, text generation, and question answering. As their applications extend to increasingly complex scenarios, however, LLMs continue to face challenges in tasks that require deep reasoning and logical inference.

arxiv-2601-09892.title: Graphs of Quasicircles and Quasiconformal Homeomorphisms
arxiv-2601-09892.creator: Katherine Williams Booth, Alexander Nolte, and Yvon Verberne
arxiv-2601-09892.description: Abstract . We give a combinatorial characterization of the group of quasiconformal homeomorphisms of a closed, oriented surface S S of genus at least 2 2 . In particular, we prove they are exactly the automorphisms of a graph of essential quasicircles on S S that respect a canonical coarse ordering induced by quality constants.

pmc-12389993.title: Sensor-Based Monitoring of Bolted Joint Reliability in Agricultural Machinery: Performance and Environmental Challenges
pmc-12389993.creator: Xinyang Gu, Bangzhui Wang, Zhong Tang, Haiyang Wang
pmc-12389993.description: The structural reliability of agricultural machinery is critically dependent on bolted joints, with loosening being a significant and prevalent failure mode. Harsh operational environments (intense vibration, impact, corrosion) severely exacerbate loosening risks, compromising machinery performance and safety. Traditional periodic inspections are inadequate for preventing sudden failures induced by loosening, leading to impaired efficiency and safety hazards.

pmc-13321648.title: Prognostic nutritional index and long-term outcomes after coronary artery bypass grafting
pmc-13321648.creator: Haichang Xu, Weiqiang Li, Shen-an-nan Chen, Shuaishuai Zhao, Chengtao Peng, Kang Huang, Xueliang Zhou, Qicai Wu
pmc-13321648.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). AimsThis study examined whether preoperative prognostic nutritional index (PNI) was related to long-term major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), all-cause mortality, and cardiovascular mortality in patients with coronary heart disease (CHD) undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG).MethodsThis single-center retrospective cohort study analyzed 550 patients with CHD who underwent CABG at the First Affiliated Hospital of Nanchang University between January 2014 and August 2025. PNI was treated as both a continuous variable and tertiles.

pmc-13372240.title: Design and in silico validation of donor DNA for RNA-guided recombinase-mediated knockout of mstnb gene in Labeo rohita
pmc-13372240.creator: Lukram Sushil Singh, Porkodi Murugesan, Gowhar Iqbal, Nagavara C. Nidarshan, Harini Gunasekaran, Ad. Viralkumar, Kiran D. Rasal, Manoj P. Brahmane, Sunil K. Nayak, Arvind A. Sonwane, Mukunda Goswami
pmc-13372240.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Myostatin b (mstnb), a key negative regulator of skeletal muscle growth, represents a promising target gene for genome editing aimed at enhancing growth performance and aquaculture productivity. The present study aimed to design, construct and in silico validate a donor DNA carrying a single-nucleotide substitution that introduces a premature stop codon in the mstnb gene of Labeo rohita for RNA-guided recombinase (RGR) platform-mediated genome editing.

pmc-13413851.title: Humic Acid Recovery from Leachate Nanofiltration Concentrate Using Halloysite Nanotube-Coated Tubular Ceramic Ultrafiltration Membrane
pmc-13413851.creator: Sultan Akarçay Demir, Gamze Varank, Derya Y. Koseoglu-Imer, Gülay Arslan Cene, Emine Can-Güven, Senem Yazici Guvenc, Oruc Kaan Turk
pmc-13413851.description: Landfill wastewater is a serious environmental problem and represents a high-concentration source of valuable organic compounds such as humic acids (HAs). The nanofiltration (NF) concentrate generated during treatment poses an even more significant environmental challenge, and the recovery of these substances is compatible with circular economy principles but requires innovative, pollution-resistant separation technologies.
